services.desc: Okanagan Lake provides a wide variety of fishing opportunities for Kokanee, Lake Whitefish, Burbot and Rainbow Trout. The waters of Okanagan Lake are currently home to many species both indigenous and non indigenous, including Kokanee salmon, the native strain of trophy Rainbow Trout exclusive to the Okanagan, as well as Lake Trout, Burbot, Northern Pike Minnow, Mountain Whitefish, Lake Whitefish, Carp, Sucker, Bass and Pumpkin Seed. Legend to be home of the Ogopogo, Squally Point is a noticeable sharp elbow on the eastside of Okanagan lake, south of Rattlesnake Island and within the Okanagan Mountain Park Region.
